title: Standing rules v1 (bp-rules.json)
description: The owner's standing rules of one product, at <root>/.ai/lens-scan/work/bp-rules.json: orders (hold, only, cap) and grants. Normative text: docs/standard/rules-1.md. Types: packages/core/src/scan/rules.ts (Rule, RulesFile, HeldEntry). Required and optional fields follow the Rule interface; the per-kind requirements bp's write path adds (only needs lenses, cap needs maxEffort, a grant needs expiresAt) are stated in rules-1.md and not enforced here. Unknown keys are allowed: readers ignore them.

rules.description: Every rule ever set, newest last; revoked and expired rules stay as the record.

id.description: O-n for an order (hold, only, cap), G-n for a grant; numbered per product, never reused.

text.description: The rule in the owner's words.

by.description: Who set it: user:<gh login>, else user:blueprint.

at.description: When it was set; live from this moment.

lenses.description: only: the lenses whose work may still start in the place.

maxEffort.description: cap: the highest effort a build in the place may run at.

model.description: cap: only builds on this model are capped; absent = every model.

minTier.description: grant: findings of this tier or milder (0 stop-ship .. 3 backlog); absent = any tier.

tools.description: grant: the agent tools it lets run without a card; absent = decision.answer and wave.dispatch.

evidence.description: What the replay said when the rule was set.

scope.description: A ScanScope: the place a rule governs, its features resolved when the rule was written.

id.description: The place id (a feature slug, capability, domain or wing id); absent for all.

heldEntry.description: One line of bp-rules-log.jsonl (HeldEntry): a door that held items under an order, or refused the act.

tool.description: wave.compose, wave.dispatch, dispatch, lens.execute or scan.place.
